inputs.original_text: Phoenix leaders are calling Wednesday night’s vote “oversight,” but it sounds like cover for controlling where federal immigration enforcement can operate and what the public is allowed to see. The restrictions put the power in city officials’ hands to set the rules and manage the story. The accountability pitch is part of the maneuver, not a reason to take their explanation at face value.

The accountability argument seems part of the maneuver, not a reason to take their explanation at face value.
